What law programs are offered under Maharaja Krishnakumarsinhji Bhavnagar University?

Maharaja Krishnakumarsinhji Bhavnagar University offers 3-Year LL.B., 5-Year Integrated B.A. LL.B., and 2-Year LL.M. degree programs under its official faculty of law.
